notes.title: UPDATE V4.3
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

A new update has come for Home Design 3D!
You can find more details about this version 4.3 [url=https://en.homedesign3d.net/2018/12/19/update-v4-3/]HERE[/url]

[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Multi-selection feature![/b] You can select several items and move them around at the same time, copy the group of same objects in one move
[*] [b]New project menu[/b]: improved interface to easily manage your projects. Select several projects and save/share them at the same time
[*] Improved ergonomics with written feedbacks
[/list]

[h1][b]Additional content[/b][/h1]
[*] New interface: modern and elegant
[*] Snap feature improved by snapping object to another object
[*] New objects including many stairs designs!
[*] General optimization and bug fix

We hope you will enjoy this update. Feel free to share your feedback!

- The Home Design 3D Team

notes.title: NEWS FLOORS FEATURE
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Many of you asked news about the future floors feature. 

Yes it is still [b]in development[/b] and our team is working hard on it. It is a really [b]ambitious and complex feature[/b] which has a huge impact on the production. Indeed to make it possible, the team even had to entirely recode the architecture engine. 

We really want to offer you an easy, intuitive and efficient feature as much as possible. But that [b]requires time and a lot of programming and testing.[/b] 

Meanwhile, here is a little screenshot! [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10881986/c4b41f58de5d86ee7f922bac2ab3cd7a760a4a1f.png[/img]


[b]Last info[/b], we are considering to organize a Steam Beta Test when the feature will be ready enough. We will publish further info in due course. 

Thank you for patience and understanding! 

The Home Design 3D Team

notes.title: UPDATE 4.1.1 - PRINT 3D
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

The new update 4.1.1 is online! It brings many big changes and a new feature!

[h1]3D printing Color service[/h1]

As 3D printing technology is going more and more important in the interior design field, we notice that it is only accessible to a few. With this new Home Design 3D feature, this technology is now available to anyone, no need to have a 3D printer at home, or to contact a specialized company. 

Create a project in Home Design 3D, click on the 3D Printer Icon, visualize the virtual 3D printed model of your project then choose a scale. Enter your info, validate your order and receive it at home! 

All our 3D printed models are made from [b] high professional quality printers[/b] in color, thanks to the ColorJet Printing (CJP) technology. Before any printing, an operator/infographist checks the 3D model and adjusts it if necessary. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10881986/4971b13572d9afe3473cb5f84364fdb4c2f1e3a0.png[/img]

Click on the 3D Printer Icon at the right of the main bar menu and see by yourself :). 

[h1]Other new changes:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]+130 new objects, including cars! 
    [*]New advanced graphical parameters --> [b]'Gear'[/b] icon
    [*]Help section improved: better pages, contents, video tutorials --> [b]'?'[/b] icon
    [*]Bug fixes

notes.title: [11/17/2016] Major update Version 4.0
notes.content:
[b]Please notice that starting with this version Windows 32 bits support is dropped.[/b]

[h1]Significative changes:[/h1]
[list]
  [*]New user interface
  [*]Render engine improvements:
  [list]
    [*]Optimizations
    [*]Shadow maps
    [*]Cell shading post effect
    [*]SAO post effect
    [*]Fixes and improvements on the lighting
  [/list]
  [*]Copy/Past of objects
  [*]Project sharing : export in hd3d file
  [*]Integrated capture feature
  [*]Color chart to customize textures
  [*]Adding the plot tracing tool
  [*]Major refactoring on how we update the architecture
[/list]

[h1]More information about the architecture refactoring:[/h1]
This refactoring helps us to fix a lot of small issues and allow us to make some optimizations. It will also be a good base to add floors.

[h1]Other changes (some aren't listed):[/h1]
[list]
  [*]Integration of crash reporting of steam 
  [*]Crash at startup on "Nvidia Optimus" and "Amd Power Xpress" should be fixed
  [*]Memory consumption and performances improvement
  [*]Improvement of numerous objects (We are still working on adding new objects and improving their quality)
  [*]Application should start faster
  [*]New default projects
  [*]Cotations marking the distance between objects are editable (We have some other projects to improve the edition)
  [*]Swimming pool are now doing a hole in the ground
  [*]Language selection can be switch in game properties from your steam library
  [*]Adding texture import
  [*]Adding object's height scale
  [*]Eyedropper tool to find a used material
[/list]
